name: Burger World
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Burger World in Imst – where tradition meets modern flair!**

Nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Imst** is a charming town that perfectly blends alpine beauty with a vibrant local culture. And at the center of this culinary scene is **Burger World**—your go-to spot for mouthwatering burgers, crispy fries, and refreshing drinks.

Whether you're craving a classic **Cheeseburger**, a juicy **Bacon Burger**, or something more adventurous like a **Spicy Jalapeño Burger**, our menu has it all. And don’t forget to try our famous **Kaiserschmarrn** for dessert—fluffy, caramelized, and simply irresistible!

After your meal, take a stroll through **Imst**’s picturesque streets, visit the historic **Stadtpfarrkirche**, or explore the stunning **Karwendel Mountains** just outside town. **Burger World** is the perfect starting point for your adventure in **Tirol**!

<iframe src="https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=..." width="600" height="450" style="border:0;" allowfullscreen="" loading="lazy"></iframe>

**Come hungry, leave happy—Burger World in Imst awaits!** 🍔✨
